Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the nature of somatic cell mutations by incorrectly assuming they directly affect gamete formation through somatic support cells. This reflects a misunderstanding since somatic cell mutations do not typically affect gamete formation, as gametes are derived from germline mutations. The error also involves prematurely concluding the task based on internal assumptions without consulting a specialist or cross-referencing biological principles, leading to the incorrect selection of answer B instead of the correct C (leading to tumors in tissue).
